notes: Organization responsible for personal info under its control
Purposes identified at or before time of collection
Knowledge and consent required; withdrawal must be possible (4.3.8)
Collect only what is necessary for identified purposes
Retain only as long as necessary for the purpose
Information shall be as accurate, complete, and up-to-date as necessary
Security safeguards appropriate to sensitivity of information
Policies and practices relating to management of personal info
Individual shall be informed of existence, use, and disclosure of their info
Individual may challenge compliance with above principles
